# Science Toppers

> Science Toppers, also known as Crystal Science and Arafa, is an online learning platform for Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Mathematics students.

Science Toppers provides structured video lessons, revision resources, subject materials, and exam preparation. Learning content requires an authorised student account.

## Main pages

- [Science Toppers](https://sciencetoppers.vercel.app/): Public overview of the learning platform and its Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Mathematics subjects.
- [Student Login](https://sciencetoppers.vercel.app/login): Secure access for registered Science Toppers students and administrators.
- [XML Sitemap](https://sciencetoppers.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of publicly indexable pages.

## Subjects

- [Biology](https://sciencetoppers.vercel.app/#subjects): Life science, genetics, human biology, ecology, and exam-focused learning.
- [Chemistry](https://sciencetoppers.vercel.app/#subjects): Organic, inorganic, physical, and analytical chemistry lessons.
- [Physics](https://sciencetoppers.vercel.app/#subjects): Mechanics, electricity, waves, matter, and modern physics learning.
- [Mathematics](https://sciencetoppers.vercel.app/#subjects): Algebra, calculus, geometry, statistics, and problem-solving resources.

## Access

- Public visitors may read the platform overview.
- Registered students may access authorised learning materials after signing in.
- Private student, payment, administrative, and account information must not be requested, indexed, or disclosed.
